Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der QC Late Phase suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Scientist Quality Control mit Fokus GC, GC-MS & IC (a), 100% - (befristet 12 Monate)

Dabei sind Sie der Ansprechpartner für Fachfragen interner und externer Kunden sowie Behörden. Durch fundierte fachliche Beurteilung und Zweitkontrollen stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Ergebnisse unseren hohen Qualitätsstandards entsprechen – wissenschaftlich fundiert, nachvollziehbar und präzise.

• Sie entwickeln GC-, GC-MS- und IC-analytische Methoden und führen Methodenvalidierungen und Transfers gemäss regulatorischer Anforderungen (cGMP) durch.

• In interdisziplinären Projektteams bringen Sie Ihre Expertise ein und übernehmen fachliche Verantwortung. Sie kommunizieren klar mit internen Schnittstellen wie QA, Produktion oder Regulatory Affairs und tragen so zur Qualität entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette bei.

• Sie halten alle relevanten Weisungen, Vorschriften und Vorgaben zur Sicherstellung der Korrektheit der täglichen Arbeit gemäß cGMP, Arbeitssicherheit und Umweltschutz ein, setzen diese aktiv um und sind dabei ein Vorbild für das Team.

• Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die Bearbeitung und den Abschluss von Q-Events (OOX’s, Deviations). Dabei erstellen und kontrollieren Sie QC-Daten, -Dokumente und bearbeiten Incidents sowie technische Berichte.

• Sie prüfen und erstellen QC-Dokumente und setzen regulatorische Anforderungen (cGMP) konsequent um. Ihr vorausschauender Blick lässt Sie dabei Compliance-Änderungen erkennen und frühzeitig etablieren.

• Sie engagieren sich für die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von QC-Prozessen, dokumentieren fachliche Erkenntnisse systematisch und stärken durch aktiven Wissensaustausch eine gemeinsame Qualitätskultur im Team.

• Abgeschlossenes Studium MSc / PhD in Naturwissenschaften (FH, Uni)

• Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie und im GMP-Umfeld

• Fachwissen im analytischen Umfeld im Umgang mit chromatographischen Methoden, GC, GC-MS & IC wünschenswert

• Kenntnisse Analytische Methodenvalidierung & Transfers im regulierten GMP-Umfeld

• Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen

• Kommunikatives und gut strukturiertes Organisationstalent

Il tuo profilo:

• Esperienza pratica con sistemi di controllo del processo, Siemens PCS7, WinCC e Simatic Batch, nonché strumenti di simulazione come SIMIT o piattaforme simili

• Solida comprensione dell'hardware di automazione, PLC, controller, strumentazione di campo, integrazione di sistema e protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio, OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Conoscenza pratica dell'infrastruttura IT/OT, inclusa virtualizzazione, amministrazione Windows, rete TCP/IP, ambienti virtuali (ad esempio, VMware, Proxmox) e segmentazione di rete nelle configurazioni di laboratorio

• Esposizione ai sistemi di dati (ad esempio, storici, MES, piattaforme di analisi), la loro integrazione con i sistemi di automazione e l'esperienza nella messa in servizio virtuale e negli approcci gemelli digitali

• Forte capacità di problem solving con la capacità di lavorare attraverso le discipline, agire come un allrounder tecnico, e tradurre le esigenze degli utenti in soluzioni tecniche pratiche

• Personalità dedicata, autodidatta, strutturata e collaborativa con una mentalità hands-on; la solida conoscenza del tedesco è considerata un vantaggio forte

• Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

• Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

The Head of Innovation in Engineering drives innovation across Bachem’s global engineering and manufacturing network by identifying, evaluating, and implementing emerging technologies, processes, and engineering solutions that enhance operational excellence, manufacturing capabilities, sustainability, digitalization, and competitiveness. In close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners, the role leads technology scouting and manages a structured innovation pipeline from ideation to deployment, ensuring alignment with Bachem’s strategic growth objectives.

Your tasks:

• Develop and execute Bachem’s global Engineering Innovation Strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with business objectives.

• Scout, assess, and advance emerging technologies and market trends relevant to peptide and oligonucleotide manufacturing, API production, and the CDMO industry

• Lead innovation initiatives across engineering and manufacturing, focusing on automation, digitalization, AI, advanced analytics, smart manufacturing, and process intensification

• Evaluate, pilot, and scale innovative technologies and engineering solutions to improve manufacturing performance, operational excellence, and competitiveness

• Drive digital transformation initiatives in Engineering in collaboration with Engineering, IT/OT, and Automation teams to enhance productivity, quality, compliance, and operational performance

• Establish innovation governance, manage the innovation portfolio, and develop business cases and ROI assessments to ensure strategic value creation

• Build and maintain strategic partnerships with technology providers, research institutions, startups, and industry networks to accelerate innovation and technology adoption

• Champion sustainable manufacturing by identifying and implementing technologies that improve energy efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and support future manufacturing concepts and plant designs

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Biochemical or Pharmaceutical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline

• PhD and/or MBA is a strong plus

• Minimum 10 years of engineering and manufacturing experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical, or CDMO/CMO industry

• Proven leadership experience (5+ years) in engineering, manufacturing technology, innovation, operational excellence, or a related function

• Demonstrated track record in developing and implementing innovation strategies, technology roadmaps, and transformative engineering solutions

• Strong knowledge of modern manufacturing technologies, including automation, digital manufacturing, advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and smart manufacturing concepts

• Experience evaluating, scaling, and deploying new technologies in GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, with a strong understanding of business case development and value realization

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build partnerships across functions and external innovation networks

• Entrepreneurial, strategic, and change-oriented leader with strong business acumen

• Fluent in English, German is a very strong plus

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%.

Your Tasks:

• Lead the full lifecycle management of the Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution System (MES), including solution design, configuration, deployment, validation, maintenance, and continuous improvement

• Support the design and implementation of next-generation MES architectures aligned with smart manufacturing, digital plant strategies, and Pharma 4.0 initiatives

• Drive MES activities across the new facility startup lifecycle, from project design and commissioning through qualification, go-live, and commercial manufacturing operations

• Collaborate with manufacturing, automation, IT/OT, quality, engineering, and global digital teams to define and implement scalable PAS-X solutions

• Translate business and manufacturing process requirements into robust MES functional and technical designs

• Ensure high system availability, reliability, and performance for GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, including on-call and operational support where required

• Manage change control, deviation investigations, incident management, and problem resolution in close collaboration with IT, operations, and system vendors

• Support integration of PAS-X with enterprise and shopfloor systems including ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automation and integration platforms

• Contribute to MES platform standardization, template strategies, and deployment methodologies across global manufacturing sites

• Maintain GMP-compliant documentation throughout the system lifecycle, including specifications, risk assessments, validation deliverables, and operational procedures

• Act as MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, qualification activities, and regulatory interactions

• Support commissioning, qualification, and computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) activities in accordance with GAMP5 and data integrity requirements

Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

• 4 – 6 years of strong hands-on experience with Körber PAS-X MES in regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing environments

• Proven experience supporting MES implementation projects for new manufacturing facilities, site expansions, or large-scale digital transformation programs

• Solid understanding of next-generation MES/IT-OT architectures, system integrations, and smart factory concepts

• Experience with PAS-X modules such as electronic batch records (EBR), materials management, weigh & dispense, workflow design, and master batch record modeling is highly desirable

• Administer a 24/7 operational MES System, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.

• Knowledge of system integration technologies, infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity within GMP manufacturing environments

• Experience with computerized system validation (CSV/CSA), data integrity, and regulatory compliance requirements including GAMP5, Annex 11, and 21 CFR Part 11

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, commissioning and qualification activities, and operational readiness for facility startup

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced project and operational environments

• Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable

Our offer

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our new location in Stein!

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated PI Data Historian, Integration System Engineer (a), workload 80 - 100%.

Your tasks:

• Manage the full lifecycle of the AVEVA PI Data Historian System, including architecture, development, installation, commissioning, maintenance, upgrades, and decommissioning activities.

• Support greenfield and brownfield manufacturing site projects, including deployment of PI infrastructure for new production facilities and expansion projects.

• Lead PI System implementation activities during new manufacturing site start-up phases, including system design, validation, commissioning, and operational readiness.

• Administer a 24/7 operational PI System, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.

• Design, implement, and optimize historian solutions integrating OT equipment, PLCs, SCADA, DCS, MES, and enterprise IT systems.

• Drive end-to-end IT/OT integration activities to enable seamless data flow between manufacturing equipment, automation systems, and business applications.

• Collaborate closely with automation, infrastructure, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and digitalization teams to ensure compliant and scalable system integration.

• Lead change, incident, and problem management processes in collaboration with IT/OT teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and end users.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to industrial data collection, communication interfaces, data storage, synchronization, and retrieval.

• Translate business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions aligned with manufacturing and digital transformation strategies.
Design and configure complex PI tags, AF structures, event frames, and data models tailored to operational and business needs.

• Develop and maintain custom interfaces, connectors, and scripts to enhance interoperability between OT equipment and enterprise IT platforms.

• Support commissioning and qualification activities for connected manufacturing systems and ensure compliance with GMP and validation requirements.

• Conduct system performance analysis and drive continuous improvement initiatives for historian and integration platforms.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and project team members.

• Collaborate with external vendors, system integrators, and engineering partners during project execution and operational support activities.

• Create and maintain comprehensive GMP-compliant documentation, including design specifications, test protocols, validation records, SOPs, and lifecycle documents.

• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, and assessments, ensuring compliance with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and data integrity principles.

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 4 - 6 years of hands-on experience in PI Historian engineering, system integration, and technical project delivery within pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

• Proven hands-on experience with the AVEVA PI Data Historian System, including PI Server, PI AF, PI Vision, Interfaces, Connectors & Adaptors.

• Strong project experience supporting new manufacturing site deployments, commissioning activities, or large-scale production expansion projects.

• Demonstrated experience integrating OT equipment and industrial automation systems with enterprise IT infrastructure and applications.

• Solid understanding of industrial communication protocols such as OPC DA/UA, modbus, MQTT, BACnet, or Ethernet/IP.

• Strong background in managing and administering production-critical applications in regulated manufacturing environments.

• Experience working with PLCs, SCADA, DCS, MES, manufacturing execution & integration platform architectures.

• Familiarity with infrastructure technologies including Windows Server, virtualization, networking, Active Directory, backup/recovery, and cybersecurity principles.

• Experience with Computerized System Validation (CSV), GMP compliance, and data integrity requirements within regulated industries.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work across IT and OT domains.

• In-depth knowledge of industrial data integration, historian system architecture, and real-time data management.

• Understanding of manufacturing processes, automation systems, and digital manufacturing initiatives.

• Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for system administration and workflow automation.

• Experience with data contextualization, visualization, reporting, and analytics platforms.

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global project environments.

• Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable

Our offer

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our new location in Stein!

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100% Descrizione Per supportare la nostra crescita organica continua, stiamo cercando professionisti altamente qualificati. Per aumentare la nostra squadra nel dipartimento IT globale, stiamo cercando un Global IT/OT Network Architect dedicato (f/m/d), 100%. Il Global IT/OT Network Architect definisce e governa l'architettura di rete globale dell'azienda in ambienti IT aziendali e tecnologie operative, supportando direttamente la strategia digitale di Bachem (manifattura digitale, concetti Pharma 4.0). Il ruolo combina la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione dell'architettura di rete aziendale e industriale/OT, nonché l'architettura delle soluzioni a livello di sito per uffici, ambienti di produzione, laboratori, inclusa una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine. Il ruolo garantito che le reti IT e OT siano sicure, resilienti, scalabili, standardizzate, manutenibili e allineate ai requisiti aziendali, operative, di sicurezza informatica e di conformità GxP. Compiti - Definire e mantenere gli standard di architettura di rete globale per gli ambienti aziendali, industriali, cloud e sito in tutto il mondo. Assumi la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione per l'architettura di rete globale. - Supportare la strategia digitale di Bachem, in particolare la manifattura digitale e i concetti Pharma 4.0, e fornire la governance tecnica per i fornitori di servizi organizzati, le compagnie telefoniche, i fornitori di automazione e gli integratori di sistemi OT. - Possedere una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine, inclusi la modernizzazione, la standardizzazione, la riduzione del debito tecnico e la pianificazione della fine del ciclo di vita. - Progettare architetture di rete OT sicuro e resilienti per gli ambienti di produzione a piano terra, inclusa la segmentazione IT/OT local Zone, condottier, DMZ, firewall, VLAN, controlli di accesso e flussi di dati controllati. - Garantire che i progetti di rete locali siano allineati con gli standard globali e le esigenze operative site-specific attraverso il supporto alle revisioni di progettazione, alla messa in servizio, ai passaggi, alle migrazioni, ai test di accettazione e alla validazione post-implementazione. - Garantire che l'architettura della rete supporti i requisiti di sicurezza informatica, il rischio e la conformità GxP in tutto l'IT e l'OT allineandosi con le politiche interna e gli standard definiti come IEC 62443, ISO 27001, le linee guida sulla sicurezza OT di NIST e le pratiche ITIL. - Mantenere la documentazione dell'architettura, inclusi gli standard, le architetture di riferimento, i piani delle site, i modelli di segmentazione, i template di progettazione, i registri delle decisioni, le teorie e la documentazione di accettazione del rischio. - Garantire che le progettazioni siano supportate operativemente dagli team IT, OT, site e dei servizi idonei, e definire i manuali operativi, i modelli di supporto, i percorsi di escalation e i requisiti di recupero di emergenza. Profilo - Esperienza estesa in architettura di rete, architettura dell'obiettivo o ingegneria di rete senior in ambienti aziendali globali o multi-sito, garantendo la conformità GxP. - Esperienza pratica con le reti OT o industriale progettando la segmentazione IT/OT e i modelli di connessione sicura nella manifattura, nella farmaceutica o in ambienti simili. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100%.

The Global IT/OT Network Architect defines and governs the company’s global network architecture across enterprise IT and operational technology environments, directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts).

The role combines full ownership and design authority of enterprise & industrial/OT network architecture, and site-level solution architecture for offices, production environments, warehouses, and laboratories, including a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap.

The role ensures that IT and OT networks are secure, resilient, scalable, standardized, maintainable, and aligned with business, operational, cybersecurity, and GxP compliance requirements.

Your tasks :

• Define and maintain global network architecture standards for enterprise, industrial, cloud, and site environments across global sites. Assume full ownership and design authority for global network architecture.

• Support Bachem’s digital strategy, in particular digital manufacturing and Pharma 4.0 concepts, and provide technical governance for managed service providers, telecom carriers, automation vendors, and OT system integrators.

• Own a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap, including modernization, standardization, technical debt reduction, and end-of-life planning.

• Design secure and resilient OT network architectures for shop-floor and production environments, including IT/OT segmentation using zones, conduits, DMZs, firewalls, VLANs, access controls, and controlled data flows.

• Ensure local network designs align with global standards and site-specific operational needs by supporting design reviews, commissioning, cutovers, migrations, acceptance testing, and post-implementation validation.

• Ensure network architecture supports cybersecurity, risk, and GxP compliance requirements across IT and OT by aligning with internal policies and relevant standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST OT security guidance, and ITIL practices.

• Maintain architecture documentation, including standards, reference architectures, site blueprints, segmentation models, design templates, decision records, exceptions, and risk acceptance documentation.

• Ensure designs are operationally supportable by IT, OT, site, and managed service teams, and define operational runbooks, support models, escalation paths, and disaster recovery requirements.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture, infrastructure architecture, or senior network engineering in global or multi-site enterprise environments, ensuring GxP compliance.

• Practical experience with OT or industrial networks designing IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity patterns in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, or similar environments.

• Experience with architecture governance, technical standards, design documentation (HLD, LLD, standards, reference architectures, diagrams, decision records, and risk documentation).

• CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent enterprise networking certification.

• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent security certification in addition to IEC 62443.

• ITIL Foundation or higher, TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification.

• Cloud networking certification for Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

Al fine di guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro laboratorio di approvazione del dipartimento di sviluppo QC Early Phase, siamo alla ricerca di un Controllo Qualità Associate Scientist.

Stiamo cercando:

Come personalità impegnata e motivata, fai parte del nostro dipartimento di sviluppo agile. Una vasta gamma di compiti e domande vi aspettano in un ambiente dinamico ed emozionante. Siete responsabili delle analisi dei principi attivi oligonucleotide sotto GMP e dei loro test di stabilità.

I vostri compiti:

• Utilizzo di metodi cromatografici per il rilascio e il test di stabilità dei nostri principi attivi sotto GMP

• Documentazione consapevole, valutazione e revisione delle analisi

• Cooperazione nella manutenzione e nella qualificazione delle attrezzature di analisi

• Partecipazione a progetti di ottimizzazione e sviluppo

• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale partecipando all'implementazione e alla documentazione software-based delle analisi GMP

• Chiudi la collaborazione in un team dinamico motivato, tra cui lavorare con i nostri sviluppatori di metodi

Il tuo profilo professionale:

• Studi completi in chimica, chimica alimentare o farmacia

• Esperienza professionale o focus di formazione nell'analisi strumentale con focus sulla cromatografia (HPLC)

• Esperienza nell'analisi degli oligonucleotidi

• Conoscenza delle applicazioni IT comuni comuni nell'ambiente GMP (ad esempio Chromeleon, LIMS, SAP) e affinità software generale

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

Il tuo profilo umano:

• Giocatore di squadra

• Personalità affidabile con entusiasmo per responsabilità e iniziativa

• Teamplayer

Afin de stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre laboratoire d'approbation du département de développement de la phase initiale du QC, nous cherchons un scientifique associé dédié au contrôle de la qualité.

Nous cherchons:

En tant que personnalité engagée et motivée, vous faites partie de notre département de développement agile. Un large éventail de tâches et de questions vous attendent dans un environnement dynamique et passionnant. Vous êtes responsable des analyses des ingrédients actifs de l'oligonucléotide dans le cadre des BPF ainsi que de leurs tests de stabilité.

Vos tâches:

• Utilisation de méthodes chromatographiques pour les essais de libération et de stabilité de nos ingrédients actifs sous GMP

• Documentation consciente, évaluation et examen des analyses

• Coopération dans l'entretien et la qualification des équipements d'analyse

• Participation à des projets d ' optimisation et de développement

• Possibilité de perfectionnement professionnel en participant à la mise en œuvre de logiciels et à la documentation des analyses des BPF

• Développement d'améliorations durables pour toutes les questions analytiques du cycle de vie de la méthode

• Collaboration étroite dans une équipe dynamique motivée, y compris en travaillant avec nos développeurs de méthodes

Votre profil professionnel:

• Études terminées en chimie, chimie alimentaire ou pharmacie

• Expérience professionnelle ou formation centrée sur l'analyse instrumentale avec accent sur la chromatographie (HPLC)

• Expérience dans l'analyse des oligonucléotides

• Connaissance des applications informatiques courantes dans l'environnement GMP (par exemple Chromeleon, LIMS, SAP) ainsi que l'affinité générale des logiciels

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

Votre profil humain :

• Joueur d'équipe

• Personnalité fiable avec enthousiasme pour la responsabilité et l'initiative

descriptionByLocale.it:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Chromatographie suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Chemie-& Pharmatechnologe im Schichtbetrieb (a), in Vollzeit .

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung chemischer Prozessschritte im Produktionsumfeld (z. B. Zyklisierung, Decarboxylierung, Faltung, Destillation) gemäss Herstellvorschriften

• Herstellung und Handling von Puffern, Lösungen, Lösungsmitteln, Wirkstoffen und Suspensionen inkl. Vorlegen/Einziehen von Prozesslösungen gemäss HVO

• Filtration von Prozess- und Produktlösungen sowie Packen/Entpacken von Chromatographiesäulen inkl. Vorbereitung von Säulen-Suspensionen

• Prozesskontrolle inkl. Scannen, Wiegen, Kalibrieren von pH-Messgeräten, pH-Einstellung, Probenzug und Anmeldung zur Analytik

• Bedienung von Automationssystemen (SIMATIC PCS7 / PAX X, WinCC, SIMATIC Batch) sowie grundlegendes Verständnis von Verdränger- und Kreiselpumpen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/-login EFZ (oder vergleichbar) oder mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Produktionsumfeld

• Fundiertes Verständnis für Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Bereitschaft zum Mehrschichtmodell: 3-3-3 (3 Früh-3 Spät- 3 Frei) sowie 6-4 Schichtbetrieb (6 Tage Arbeit – 4 Tage frei)

• Idealerweise Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie im Umgang mit Produktionsanlagen und Reaktoren

• Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in HPLC, Ultrafiltration (UF/DF) oder elektronischen Batch Records (z. B. PAS-X)

• Interesse an kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement, 5S) und an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

• Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

Per questo grande progetto di investimento CAPEX, stiamo cercando un esperto Senior Process Automation Engineer (f/m/d) con un focus sull'automazione di elaborazione a valle. I vostri compiti: Sei un esperto tecnico (PMI) per l'automazione dei processi (DSP) all'interno di un importante progetto CAPEX (> CHF 100 milioni) Progettazione, sviluppo e realizzazione di soluzioni di automazione (Level 0–2.5) per operazioni di unità a valle: Cromatografia Filtrazione (UF/DF, TFF) Processi di purificazione Tradurre i requisiti di processo in concetti di automazione, logica batch e strategie di controllo Revisione e ottimizzazione dei progetti di automazione e delle architetture di sistema in collaborazione con partner esterni Integrare i sistemi nel panorama complessivo dell'automazione (DCS, PLC, MES, Historian) Assicurare la conformità a GMP, GAMP5, requisiti di integrità e convalida dei dati Coordinare e condurre aziende di ingegneria esterna, integratori di sistemi e appaltatori Collaborare a stretto contatto con Ingegneria, MSAT, IT/OT e Qualità Sostenere il progetto dalla fase concettuale attraverso la messa in servizio, la qualificazione e la consegna Contribuire alla standardizzazione e allo sviluppo di concetti di automazione per il nuovo sito Assicurare la consegna in termini di qualità, budget e timeline Il tuo profilo: Laurea in automazione, ingegneria chimica, biotecnologia o settore correlato Almeno 8-10 anni di esperienza nell'automazione in ambienti farmaceutici o biotecnologici Forte competenza in: Automazione del processo a valle (cromatografia, filtrazione, purificazione) Sistema DCS (Siemens PCS7, PCSneo), PLC (ad esempio Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA (WinCC) e controllo batch Esperienza con MES, storico e integrazione dati/PAT Traduzione:
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

For this large-scale CAPEX investment project, we are seeking an experienced Senior Process Automation Engineer (f/m/d) with a focus on downstream processing automation .

Your tasks:

• You are a technical expert (SME) for process automation (DSP) within a major CAPEX project (> CHF 100 million)

• Design, develop, and implement automation solutions (Level 0–2.5) for downstream unit operations:

• Chromatography

• Filtration (UF/DF, TFF)

• Purification processes

• Translate process requirements into automation concepts, batch logic and control strategies

• Review and optimize automation designs and system architectures in collaboration with external partners

• Integrate systems into the overall automation landscape (DCS, PLC, MES, Historian)

• Ensure compliance with GMP, GAMP5, data integrity and validation requirements

• Coordinate and lead external engineering firms, system integrators and contractors

• Collaborate closely with Engineering, MSAT, IT/OT, and Quality

• Support the project from concept phase through commissioning, qualification, and handover

• Contribute to standardization and development of automation concepts for the new site

• Ensure delivery in terms of quality, budget, and timeline

Your profile:

• Degree in automation, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field

• At least 8–10 years of experience in automation within pharmaceutical or biotech environments

• Strong expertise in:

• Downstream process automation (chromatography, filtration, purification)

• DCS system (Siemens PCS7, PCSneo), PLC (e.g. Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA (WinCC) and batch control

• Experience with MES, historian and data/PAT integration

• Solid understanding of GMP, GAMP5 and CQV processes (IQ/OQ/PQ)

• Proven experience in CAPEX projects and interdisciplinary teams

• Independent, structured working style with high responsibility

• High resilience and flexibility

• Very good knowledge of English; German is a plus

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment

• Opportunity to shape a greenfield peptide production site

• High impact role in a strategic CAPEX program

• Flexible working conditions and development opportunities

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf and our new location in Sisslerfeld!

ICH Q7, FDA, EMA) - Expérience dans la planification et la mise en œuvre des transferts de technologie - Exploitation structurée et orientée vers la solution et capacité à développer des solutions pragmatiques même dans des situations complexes ou peu claires - Personnalité orientée équipe avec une communication claire et ouverte et la capacité de réunir différentes interfaces - Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture
• Cosa offriamo - Un environnement de travail dynamique et en expansion avec des possibilités de développement interne et de formation continue - Conception flexible du temps de travail avec possibilité de bureau à domicile et possibilité de couvrir des jours de vacances supplémentaires avec une charge de travail réduite - KITA interne au campus Bachem Bubendorf

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%. The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership. The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations. In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.
• Your tasks: Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments. Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems. Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities. Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live. Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability. Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers. Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections. Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables. Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs. Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.
• Your profile: Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security. <li style="color:#004

descriptionByLocale.it:

Interviene direttamente sulle strutture strategiche in un ambiente esigente e altamente regolamentato. Le tue responsabilità
• Assicurare assemblaggio, messa in servizio, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva di apparecchiature elettriche, strumentazione e automazione.
• Diagnosi e risoluzione dei guasti per garantire la continuità delle nostre operazioni.
• Partecipa a migliorare l'affidabilità degli impianti e proporre soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare le loro prestazioni.
• Identificare i problemi dell'obsolescenza e contribuire alla definizione degli standard tecnici di domani.
• Garantire la conformità ai requisiti GMP, ai processi CAPA e Change Control.
• Eseguire ispezioni periodiche e attività di calibrazione della strumentazione.
• Assicurare il rispetto degli standard ASE, ITTO e NIBT.
• Partecipare al servizio di picket tecnico al fine di garantire il supporto necessario per operare il sito. Il tuo profilo Sei un professionista del campo che ama capire i problemi tecnici, trovare soluzioni durevoli e lavorare in team multidisciplinari. Hai idealmente le seguenti qualifiche:
• SWC automatico, assemblatore-automatico o installatore-elettrico.
• Esperienza nei sistemi di manutenzione e automazione industriale.
• Buona conoscenza dei controllori Siemens S7 e dei protocolli di comunicazione industriale.
• Controllo della lettura di schemi elettrici, pneumatici e meccanici.
• Conoscenza di ambienti GMP o regolamentati che forniscono un vantaggio.
• Certificazione ITTO Art. 13 desiderato.
• Buon controllo degli strumenti informatici comuni e SAP.
• Il francese attuale; l'inglese e/o il tedesco sono beni. Al di là delle vostre competenze tecniche, cerchiamo una persona organizzata e autosufficiente con uno spirito analitico forte e godendo il lavoro di squadra. Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ambiente di lavoro moderno e in crescita.
• Vari progetti con alto valore aggiunto.
• Una cultura aziendale basata su collaborazione, miglioramento continuo e innovazione.
• Opportunità di sviluppo professionale e formazione continua.
• La possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla produzione di prodotti che hanno un impatto positivo sulla salute dei pazienti. Pronto a rispondere alla sfida? Unisciti a un'azienda internazionale in cui le tue competenze tecniche contribuiranno ogni giorno all'affidabilità e alle prestazioni delle nostre strutture. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to strengthen our Maintenance & Engineering team on our Vionnaz website, we are looking for a Maintenance Automatician & Instrumentation (a) passionate about technique, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Your Impact As an expert in automation, instrumentation and electrical systems, you play a key role in the availability, safety and performance of our production equipment. You intervene directly on strategic facilities in a demanding and highly regulated environment. Your Responsibilities
• Ensure assembly, commissioning, preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical equipment, instrumentation and automation.
• Diagnosis and resolve breakdowns to ensure continuity of our operations.
• Participate in improving the reliability of installations and propose innovative solutions to optimize their performance.
• Identify the problems of obsolescence and contribute to the definition of the technical standards of tomorrow.
• Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, CAPA and Change Control processes.
• Perform periodic inspections and calibration activities of instrumentation.
• Ensure compliance with ASE, ITTO and NIBT standards.
• Participate in the technical picket service in order to guarantee the support necessary to operate the site. Your profile You are a field professional who likes to understand technical problems, find durable solutions and work in multidisciplinary teams. You ideally have the following qualifications:
• SWC of automatic, assembler-automatician or installer-electrician.
• Experience in industrial maintenance and automation systems.
• Good knowledge of Siemens S7 controllers and industrial communication protocols.
• Controlling the reading of electrical, pneumatic and mechanical diagrams.
• Knowledge of GMP or regulated environments providing an advantage.
• ITTO certification Art. 13 desired.
• Good control of common computer tools and SAP.
• Current French; English and/or German are assets. Beyond your technical skills, we look for an organized, self-sustaining person with a strong analytical spirit and enjoying teamwork. What we offer you
• A modern and growing working environment.
• Various projects with high added value.
• A corporate culture based on collaboration, continuous improvement and innovation.
• Opportunities for professional development and continuing training.
• The possibility of directly contributing to the production of products that have a positive impact on patient health. Ready to meet the challenge? Join a growing international company where your technical expertise will contribute every day to the reliability and performance of our facilities. We look forward to receiving your application.

Ihre Wirkung Als Experte für Automatisierung, Messtechnik und elektrische Systeme spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Leistung unserer Produktionsanlagen. Sie greifen direkt in strategische Einrichtungen in einem anspruchsvollen und stark regulierten Umfeld ein. Ihre Aufgaben
• Montage, Inbetriebnahme, vorbeugende und korrektive Wartung von elektrischen Geräten, Instrumenten und Automatisierung.
• Diagnose und Behebung von Pannen, um die Kontinuität unserer Aktivitäten zu gewährleisten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit von Anlagen und schlagen Sie innovative Lösungen zur Optimierung ihrer Leistung vor.
• Identifizieren Sie die Probleme der Obsoleszenz und tragen Sie zur Definition der technischen Standards von morgen bei.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der GMP-Anforderungen, CAPA- und Change Control-Prozesse.
• Führen Sie regelmäßige Inspektionen und Kalibrierungsaktivitäten von Instrumenten durch.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Standards ASE, ITTO und NIBT.
• Nehmen Sie am technischen Streikpostendienst teil, um die für den Betrieb des Geländes erforderliche Unterstützung zu gewährleisten. Dein Profil Sie sind ein Feldprofi, der gerne technische Probleme versteht, dauerhafte Lösungen findet und in multidisziplinären Teams arbeitet. Idealerweise verfügen Sie über folgende Qualifikationen:
• SWC von Automatik, Monteur-Automatiker oder Installateur-Elektriker.
• Erfahrung in industriellen Wartungs- und Automatisierungssystemen.
• Gute Kenntnisse von Siemens S7 Controllern und industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen.
• Steuerung des Lesens von elektrischen, pneumatischen und mechanischen Diagrammen.
• Kenntnisse über GMP oder regulierte Umgebungen bieten einen Vorteil.
• ITTO-Zertifizierung Art. 13 gewünscht.
• Gute Kontrolle über gängige Computertools und SAP.
• Aktuelles Französisch; Englisch und / oder Deutsch sind Vermögenswerte. Über Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten hinaus suchen wir eine organisierte, selbsttragende Person mit einem starken analytischen Geist und Spaß an Teamwork. Was wir Ihnen bieten
• Ein modernes und wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld.
• Verschiedene Projekte mit hohem Mehrwert.
• Eine Unternehmenskultur, die auf Zusammenarbeit, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Innovation basiert.
• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Weiterbildung.
• Die Möglichkeit, direkt zur Herstellung von Produkten beizutragen, die sich positiv auf die Gesundheit der Patienten auswirken. Bereit für die Herausforderung? Treten Sie einem wachsenden internationalen Unternehmen bei, in dem Ihre technische Expertise jeden Tag zur Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung unserer Anlagen beiträgt. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Afin de renforcer notre équipe Maintenance & Engineering sur notre site de Vionnaz, nous recherchons un(e) Automaticien de maintenance & Instrumentation (a) passionné(e) par la technique, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue.

Votre impact

En tant qu'expert(e) des systèmes d'automation, d'instrumentation et des installations électriques, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la disponibilité, la sécurité et la performance de nos équipements de production. Vous intervenez directement sur des installations stratégiques dans un environnement exigeant et fortement réglementé.

Vos responsabilités

• Assurer le montage, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements électriques, d'instrumentation et d'automation.

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes afin de garantir la continuité de nos opérations.

• Participer à l'amélioration de la fiabilité des installations et proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser leur performance.

• Identifier les problématiques d'obsolescence et contribuer à la définition des standards techniques de demain.

• Garantir la conformité des interventions dans le respect des exigences GMP, des CAPA et des processus de Change Control.

• Réaliser les contrôles périodiques et les activités d'étalonnage des équipements d'instrumentation.

• Assurer la conformité des installations selon les normes ASE, OIBT et NIBT.

• Participer au service de piquet technique afin de garantir le support nécessaire à l'exploitation du site.

Votre profil

Vous êtes un professionnel de terrain qui aime comprendre les problèmes techniques, trouver des solutions durables et travailler au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.

Vous disposez idéalement des qualifications suivantes :

• CFC d'automaticien, de monteur-automaticien, d'installateur-électricien ou d'électronicien.

• Expérience confirmée en maintenance industrielle et en systèmes d'automation.

• Bonnes connaissances des automates Siemens S7 et des protocoles de communication industriels.

• Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques, pneumatiques et mécaniques.

• Connaissances des environnements GMP ou réglementés constituant un avantage.

• Certification OIBT art. 13 souhaitée.

• Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels et de SAP.

• Français courant ; l'anglais et/ou l'allemand sont des atouts.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne organisée, autonome, dotée d'un fort esprit d'analyse et appréciant le travail en équipe.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un environnement de travail moderne et en pleine croissance.

• Des projets variés à forte valeur ajoutée.

• Une culture d'entreprise fondée sur la collaboration, l'amélioration continue et l'innovation.

• Des opportunités de développement professionnel et de formation continue.

• La possibilité de contribuer directement à la fabrication de produits ayant un impact positif sur la santé des patients.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ?

Rejoignez une entreprise internationale en forte croissance où votre expertise technique contribuera chaque jour à la fiabilité et à la performance de nos installations.

Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.

• Lavori completi di risoluzione dei problemi sugli impianti meccanici, idraulici e pneumatici

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem progetta un nuovo sito a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale come parte della sua strategia a lungo termine per espandere significativamente la capacità produttiva. Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione di Ingegneria Globale, stiamo cercando un Senior Project Manager che terrà piena responsabilità per la consegna di progetti CAPEX di grandi e complessi e costruire team di progetto di alta qualità dal concetto iniziale fino alla disponibilità operativa.
• Responsabilità del progetto Prendere piena responsabilità per i progetti CAPEX su larga scala (>100 MCHF) in tutte le fasi del progetto – dalla fattibilità e studi di concept attraverso l'esecuzione, la messa in servizio, la qualificazione e la consegna alle operazioni

• Leader del progetto e governance del proprietario Agire come rappresentante del Titolare assicurando che la progettazione e l’esecuzione del progetto soddisfino obiettivi definiti (scopio, funzionalità, capacità, costo, programma, qualità, sicurezza e sostenibilità) Processi di governance di unità, tra cui charter di progetti, casi aziendali, ingressi URS/URB e processi decisionali strutturati in allineamento con i comitati direttivi
• Allineamento e integrazione degli Stakeholder Allineare e integrare tutti gli stakeholder chiave (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) in un unico team di progetto altamente performante e garantire una comunicazione trasparente e collaborazione
• Strategia di esecuzione e gestione dei partner Definire e gestire i modelli di consegna del progetto appropriati (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) da una prospettiva del proprietario e guidare partner di ingegneria esterna, appaltatori e fornitori
• Controllo del progetto e gestione delle prestazioni Implementare e garantire robusti controlli di progetto (scopio, programma, costo, rischio, gestione dei cambiamenti) tra cui reportistica strutturata e previsione (PMR) alla gestione senior
• Compliance e eccellenza normativa Assicurare la conformità ai requisiti GMP, agli standard aziendali, alle normative locali e ai codici di costruzione in tutte le fasi del progetto
• Pronta Commissione e funzionamento Condurre attività di messa in servizio, qualificazione e start-up e garantire una transizione regolare alle operazioni, incluso il supporto post-handover (“hypercare”) per ottenere prestazioni stabili e affidabili
• Leadership nel processo decisionale e nella risoluzione dei problemi Identificare, sfidare e valutare alternative, guidare il processo decisionale e risolvere proattivamente i problemi critici del progetto in stretta allineamento con il Comitato direttivo Il tuo profilo

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group plans a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland as part of its long-term strategy to significantly expand production capacity. The new site will play a central role in supporting Bachem’s growth ambitions in peptide manufacturing.

To strengthen our Global Engineering organization, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will take full accountability for the successful delivery of large and complex CAPEX projects and build high-performing project teams from early concept through to operational readiness.

• Overall project responsibility
Take full accountability for large-scale CAPEX projects (>100 MCHF) across all project phases – from feasibility and concept studies through execution, commissioning, qualification and handover to operations

• Building and leading high-performing teams
Establish, onboard and lead multidisciplinary project teams; define clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working, and ensure effective collaboration across all project participants

• Owner’s project leadership and governance
Act as the Owner’s representative ensuring that project design and execution meets defined objectives (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, quality, safety and sustainability)
Drive governance processes including project charters, business cases, URS/URB inputs, and structured decision-making in alignment with Steering Committees

• Stakeholder alignment and integration
Align and integrate all key stakeholders (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) into one high-performing project team and ensure transparent communication and collaboration

• Execution strategy and partner management
Define and manage appropriate project delivery models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from an Owner’s perspective and lead external engineering partners, contractors and suppliers

• Project controls and performance management
Implement and ensure robust project controls (scope, schedule, cost, risk, change management) including structured reporting and forecasting (PMR) to senior management

• Compliance and regulatory excellence
Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, corporate standards, local regulations and building codes across all project phases

• Commissioning and operational readiness
Lead commissioning, qualification and start-up activities and ensure a smooth transition to operations including post-handover support (“hypercare”) to achieve stable and reliable performance

• Leadership in decision-making and problem solving
Identify, challenge and evaluate alternatives, drive decision-making and proactively resolve critical project issues in close alignment with the Steering Committee

Your Profile

• University degree (MSc / BSc) in Engineering, Construction or related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience in managing large capital projects in an industrial, preferably GMP-regulated environment

• Proven track record in leading complex CAPEX

Per anticipare la nostra visione di una funzione QA integrata da un negozio, stiamo cercando un QA Shopfloor Manager (m/f/d) che porta sia competenze che una mentalità collaborativa al nostro team dinamico e motivato. Il candidato ideale non solo completerà le nostre capacità esistenti, ma contribuirà anche a nuove prospettive e a migliorare continuamente le nostre pratiche di qualità operativa.

I vostri compiti:

• Fornire una presenza di qualità proattiva sul pavimento del negozio per garantire operazioni di produzione ininterrotte e conformi e soddisfare l'adesione al programma

• Agire come primo punto di contatto QA per i team di produzione che permettono il processo decisionale rapido, informato e risoluzione dei problemi in tempo reale

• Garantire un supporto QA senza soluzione di continuità coordinando le funzioni QA per fornire un supporto di qualità coerente ed efficiente per la produzione e il supporto per la preparazione di risposte di qualità per le richieste dei clienti

• Rafforzare l'aderenza rigorosa alle procedure interne e ai requisiti GxP che supportano l'esecuzione giusta e minimizzano i ritardi

• Sostenere le indagini sulle deviazioni e le non-conformanze, assicurando un'analisi robusta delle cause, un'efficace applicazione CAPA e una chiusura tempestiva

• Accelerare facilitando valutazioni rapide e garantendo una documentazione di alta qualità delle materie legate alla qualità

• Rappresentare il QA nelle riunioni quotidiane e settimanali del negozio, affrontare i rischi di qualità e promuovere una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni

• Condurre e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano le prestazioni di qualità, riducono i rifiuti e aumentano l'efficienza operativa

• Promuovere una cultura di proprietà e di responsabilità sul piano del negozio, dove la qualità, la responsabilità e il miglioramento continuo sono visti come un attivatore

Il tuo profilo:

• Laurea universitaria (Bachelor/Master) in Chimica, Chimica Organica, Scienze Naturali, o una disciplina scientifica o tecnica comparabile, con esperienza rilevante nel campo

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella produzione di API, preferibilmente all'interno di un ambiente CDMO

• Competenza dimostrata nella garanzia della qualità, con esposizione diretta alle operazioni di produzione

• Forte conoscenza del lavoro di GMP, requisiti normativi e principi ALCOA+

• Alto livello di interesse per i processi produttivi e gli argomenti operativi QA, con una mentalità orientata verso le migliori pratiche e le moderne tecnologie

• Familiarità con sistemi di qualità e processi di documentazione, tra cui gestione delle deviazioni, CAPA e controllo dei cambiamenti

• Esperienza con o volontà di sviluppare competenze in Lean, Six Sigma, o altre metodologie di miglioramento continuo

• Proficiente sia scritto che parlato tedesco e inglese

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore lavorative flessibili con giorni di ufficio domestico e un'opzione per ottenere giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso alla piattaforma di benefici Swibeco con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Una vasta gamma di attività sportive gratuite sul Bachem Campus

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra posizione a Bubendorf!

To advance our vision of a shopfloor-integrated QA function, we are seeking a QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d) who brings both expertise and a collaborative mindset to our dynamic and motivated team. The ideal candidate will not only complement our existing capabilities but also contribute fresh perspectives and drive continuous improvement in our operational quality practices.

Your tasks:

• Provide proactive quality presence on the shopfloor to ensure uninterrupted, compliant manufacturing operations and meeting adherence to schedule

• Act as the primary QA point of contact for production teams enabling fast, informed decision-making and real-time issue resolution

• Ensure seamless QA support by coordinating across QA functions to deliver consistent, and efficient quality support to manufacturing and support preparing quality rated answers for customer requests

• Enforce strict adherence to internal procedures and GxP requirements supporting right-first-time execution and minimizing delays

• Support investigations into deviations and non-conformances, ensuring robust root cause analysis, effective CAPA implementation, and timely closure

• Accelerate by facilitating rapid assessments and ensuring high-quality documentation of quality-related matters

• Represent QA in daily and weekly shop floor meetings, addressing quality risks and promoting a solutions-oriented mindset

• Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency

• Foster a culture of ownership and accountability on the shopfloor , where quality, accountability, and continuous improvement is seen as an enabler

Your profile:

• University degree (Bachelor/Master) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Natural Sciences, or a comparable scientific or technical discipline, with relevant experience in the field

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in API manufacturing, preferably within a CDMO environment

• Demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, with direct exposure to manufacturing operations

• Strong working knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, and ALCOA+ principles

• High level of interest in manufacturing processes and operational QA topics, with a mindset geared toward best practices and modern technologies

• Familiarity with quality systems and documentation processes, including deviation handling, CAPA, and change control

• Experience with or willingness to develop skills in Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies

• Proficient in both written and spoken German and English

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer (a) , 100% to support our global capital projects and play a key role in the standardization and further development of C&Q processes across our international network. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and management of C&Q activities – from concept to handover – and will contribute your expertise to a wide range of projects worldwide.

Your tasks:

• Leadership of C&Q activities within multidisciplinary large capital projects

• Coordination and management of C&Q‑related deviations and changes within defined timelines and in compliance with required quality standards

• Responsibility for budget, schedule, prioritization, resources, and the quality of C&Q execution

• Analysis of options, planning of execution strategies, and development of detailed C&Q schedules

• Preparation of tender documents, support in procurement processes, and cost estimation

• Ensuring a smooth handover to Operations and Quality

• Risk management, including the derivation of proactive measures in case of deviations

• Management and onboarding of the C&Q team, including external partners

• Responsibility for training C&Q teams and ensuring adherence to internal standards

• Clear, structured, and audience‑appropriate communication with all stakeholders

• Close collaboration with global sites to harmonize C&Q standards and digital processes

• Support in supplier evaluation and coaching of local SMEs

• Active promotion of lean and agile methods within engineering and C&Q contexts

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung BBU Engineering Infrastructure eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Compliance Manager (a), 100% mit Fokus auf Infrastruktur ‑ , Utility ‑ und Engineering ‑ Compliance in einem GMP ‑ regulierten Umfeld.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Compliance & Governance

• Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der regulatorischen Compliance im Verantwortungsbereich Infrastruktur und Utilities (u. a. GMP, Annex 1, ICH, interne Regularien)

• Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Compliance‑Frameworks inkl. Richtlinien, Standards und SOPs

• Unterstützung bei der Auslegung regulatorischer Anforderungen und deren Überführung in technische und operative Prozesse

Audits, Inspektionen & Qualität

• Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbearbeitung von internen und externen Audits sowie Behördeninspektionen

• Koordination und Nachverfolgung von CAPAs, Abweichungen und Findings im zugewiesenen Verantwortungsbereich

• Sicherstellung einer audit‑ und inspektionsreifen Dokumentation

Change‑ & Risikomanagement

• Bewertung von Änderungen (Change Control) hinsichtlich regulatorischer und GMP‑relevanter Auswirkungen

• Durchführung und Moderation von Risikoanalysen (z. B. GMP‑, Compliance‑, Projekt‑ und Betriebsrisiken)

• Unterstützung von Projekten hinsichtlich Compliance‑, Qualifizierungs‑ und Validierungsanforderungen

Zusammenarbeit & Beratung

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Betrieb, QE, Produktion und externen Partnern

• Beratung von Fachabteilungen und Projektteams in Compliance‑ und Governance‑Fragestellungen

• Schulung und Sensibilisierung von Mitarbeitenden zu Compliance‑ und GMP‑Themen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel GSCM Network & Demand Center, stiamo cercando un Direttore S&OP e Network Strategy (a), 100%. I vostri compiti:
• Guidare, gestire e sviluppare continuamente l'organizzazione GSCM Network & Demand Center in linea con gli obiettivi strategici della divisione, comprendendo Qualità, Sicurezza, Persone, Innovazione, Sostenibilità, Customer Centricity e Eccellenza Operativa, nonché i principi di leadership di Bachem.
• Promuovere e guidare il processo previsionale, garantendo una continua trasparenza della domanda, dell'inventario e dell'offerta in tutto il Gruppo Bachem.
• Contabile per il processo di pianificazione delle operazioni e delle vendite globali end-to-end (S&OP), che porta la sua preparazione, esecuzione e follow-up per garantire l'allineamento tra obiettivi commerciali, operativi e finanziari
• Contabile per la progettazione e l'implementazione di reti di supply chain globali per nuovi prodotti, e lo sviluppo continuo delle reti esistenti attraverso partnership strategiche
• Guidare il processo globale di gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto (livello SKU), compresa la preparazione e l'esecuzione delle decisioni di make-or-buy e la fine alla gestione dell'inventario finale.
• Agire come punto chiave di contatto per i clienti interni ed esterni all'interno del Gruppo Bachem e rappresentare l'organizzazione GSCM in comitati e forum interni ed esterni.
• Assicurare una gestione tempestiva e accurata delle richieste dei clienti in stretta collaborazione con le organizzazioni regionali di approvvigionamento.
• Progetti cross-funzionali per migliorare le prestazioni della supply chain, la resilienza e l'efficienza.
• Assumere piena responsabilità di bilancio e centro di costo per l'unità organizzativa assegnata. Il tuo profilo:
• Istruzione tecnica o commerciale a livello universitario (FH/Università)
• Istruzione avanzata nella gestione della supply chain, idealmente tra cui una certificazione APICS.
• Esperienza in team leader, tra cui la gestione diretta delle linee e la leadership all'interno di matrice e cross organizzazioni funzionali, con la capacità di sviluppare, allenare e potenziare le persone, promuovere la collaborazione e creare un ambiente in cui i team possono crescere e avere successo insieme.
• Forte fine alla comprensione dei processi della supply chain (pianificazione, approvvigionamento, produzione, distribuzione e finanza).
• Eccellente collaborazione interfunzionale e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di allineare interessi diversi in un'organizzazione complessa e globale.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione a livello esecutivo, tra cui presentazione, negoziazione, gestione dei conflitti e risoluzione.
• Fluente in inglese e tedesco, sia scritto che parlato. <li style="color:#004080;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font- family:Ca
descriptionByLocale.en:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the GSCM Network & Demand Center, we are looking for a dedicated Director S&OP and Network Strategy (a), 100%.

Your tasks:

• Lead, manage and continuously develop the GSCM Network & Demand Center organization in line with the strategic objectives of the division, encompassing Quality, Safety, People, Innovation, Sustainability, Customer Centricity and Operational Excellence, as well as Bachem’s leadership principles.

• Own and drive the forecast-to-plan process, ensuring continuous end to end transparency of demand, inventory and supply scenarios across the entire Bachem Group.

• Accountable for the end-to-end global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, leading its preparation, execution, and follow-up to secure alignment between commercial, operational, and financial targets

• Accountable for global supply chain network design and implementation for new products, and the continuous development of existing networks through strategic partnerships

• Lead the global product lifecycle management process (SKU level), including preparation and execution of make-or-buy decisions and end to end inventory management.

• Act as a key point of contact for internal and external customers within the Bachem Group and represent the GSCM organization in internal and external committees and forums.

• Ensure timely and accurate handling of customer requests in close collaboration with the regional supply organizations.

• Lead cross-functional projects to enhance supply chain performance, resilience, and efficiency.

• Assume full budget and cost center responsibility for the assigned organizational unit.

Your profile:

• Technical or commercial education at university level (FH/University)

• Advanced education in Supply Chain Management, ideally including an APICS certification.

• Experience in leading teams, including direct line management as well as leadership within matrix and cross functional organizations, with the ability to develop, coach and empower people, foster collaboration and create an environment where teams can grow and succeed together.

• Strong end to end understanding of supply chain processes (planning, procurement, manufacturing, distribution and finance).

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse interests in a complex, global organization.

• Strong executive-level communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, conflict management and resolution.

• Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Processi ITSM di base propri — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management a livello globale, garantendo la conformità SLA e l'allineamento con SOPs/ITIL.
• Definire le metriche delle prestazioni — Impostare KPI/SLA, costruire dashboard, consegnare report mensili e gestire le escalation
• Mantenere la documentazione di processo — Creare e aggiornare le SOP, i materiali di formazione e garantire la chiarezza del ruolo con i record di formazione tracciati
• Gestione dei problemi di unità — Eseguire processi RCA, eseguire il follow-up di correzione, la comunicazione degli stakeholder e l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi
• Gestire gli errori noti — Mantenere i database dei problemi chiave e garantire soluzioni di lavoro sono documentate e condivise
• Lead CMDB governance — la propria strategia CMDB, la precisione del ciclo di vita CI, i modelli di dati e la mappatura della dipendenza dal servizio
• Assicurare la qualità dei dati CMDB — Eseguire audit, riconciliazione, risoluzione dei problemi e integrazione con i processi di cambiamento/incidente/monitoring
• Ottimizzare lo strumento CMDB — Migliorare l'utilizzo della piattaforma CMDB/asset, automatizzare tramite strumenti di scoperta e segnalare la conformità della configurazione
• Eseguire Gestione eventi — Assicurare la copertura di monitoraggio, correggere il filtro eventi/correlazione e l'escalation basata sull'impatto
• Definire l'automazione degli eventi — Mantenere le soglie, le notifiche e le risposte automatizzate/autosufficienti Il tuo profilo:
• 7+ anni nelle operazioni IT, nella gestione dei servizi o in un campo tecnico correlato, comprese le operazioni di servizio o la gestione della consegna dei servizi
• Esperienza pratica in Incident, Problema, Configurazione e/o Gestione eventi; Maggiore Incident Management è un vantaggio
• Certificazione ITIL Foundation necessaria; ITIL Intermediate/Expert a asset.
• Forte competenza tecnica cross-domain in infrastrutture, applicazioni, database e sicurezza, con una profonda comprensione delle loro interdipendenze, compresi i dispositivi di lavoro moderni, i server delle applicazioni e le piattaforme backend
• Forte capacità analitiche per identificare modelli, correlazioni e cause radice, con la capacità di condurre chiamate tecniche RCA
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, traducendo dettagli tecnici in linguaggio business- e user-friendly
• Forte facilitazione e leadership sotto pressione, con la capacità di lavorare in team globali e gestire gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli
• Esperienza con piattaforme di monitoraggio, analisi dei log e gestione dei servizi (ad esempio ServiceNow, LogicMonitor). La nostra offerta:
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne
